meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段文案变成产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有产品要上线,需要一条宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product to launch and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简报，逐步做成发布或宣传视频：抓取站点与品牌信号、定设计系统与分镜脚本、构建每一帧，最后渲染出 mp4。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布或推广一个产品，或给出任何商业网址时触发（这是商业网址的默认路线）；网站导览/展示需求也归这里。意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品官网做成一支发布宣传片
say.note: 会抓取该网址，再进入分镜与逐帧制作

say.text: 这是我们新功能的介绍，做一支功能揭示视频
say.note: 按产品发布流程规划故事与画面

say.text: 用我粘贴的这段脚本做一支产品演示视频
say.note: 脚本按原文保存，再据此生成视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video: it captures the site and brand, sets a design system, storyboard and script, builds frames, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, or give any commercial URL (its default route); site tours and showcases go here too. Unclear → /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn our product site into a launch promo video
say_en.note: Captures that URL, then storyboards and builds it

say_en.text: Here's our new feature - make a feature reveal video
say_en.note: Plans story and frames through the launch flow

say_en.text: Make a product demo video from this script I'm pasting
say_en.note: Saves the script verbatim, then builds from it
